words.sense: A brief, vivid literary snapshot of a moment or character without a developed sequence of events.
misconceptions: Any brief passage about a person must be an anecdote.

words.sense: A short account of something that actually happened, often with a small sequence and outcome.
misconceptions: Any vividly told personal memory must be a vignette.

semantic_axes.description: Whether the passage chiefly depicts a moment or recounts an actual occurrence.

edges.boundary_rule: A vignette presents a revealing snapshot without a developed incident; an anecdote recounts an actual event.
clues_b: sequence of actions with an outcome

misconceptions.M1: Any brief passage about a person must be an anecdote.
misconceptions.M2: Any vividly told personal memory must be a vignette.
misconceptions.M3: Length or humor, rather than incident versus portrait, decides the label.
